As part of KEP-2400, which is about swap enablement, a container's swap limit can be set.

As part of this KEP, swap limitation will be set to cgroup's memory.swap.max. Since the swap limitation is affected by the container's memory requests (see calculation info below), if the container's memory requests are being resized, the swap limitation needs to also be re-calculated, adapted and aligned accordingly.
